notes.note: Edwards made his BE but barely. Ideally he could be traded out as soon as you can with a new BE of 36.
Edwards returned to the side and had 14 disposals as he made his BE comfortably with his best score of the season so far. With all the injuries they got this week his spot in the side should be safe.
Not a big game for Edwards with a goal from his 9 disposals. His scoring isn't heading in the right direction and his BE is now up at 37 which is concerning.
Edwards posted his lowest score with his 10 disposals and has a BE of 16. But he is still making cash. So hold him.
Edwards was good in his third game with a couple of goals and all have been in the 50s. He left the ground for a HIA assessment with 5 mins to go but passed it so should be good to go.
